title: Countries with airports but no airlines
statementMd:
List countries that have an airport but no airline based there.

Expected columns: `country`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT country FROM airports EXCEPT SELECT country FROM airlines;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
